title: Package 01 Foundation Bootstrap
statement: First structural implementation package added safety foundation while legacy commercial behavior remained active.
notes: Builder Brain did not exist before this cycle; learnings were seeded afterward.

title: Builder Brain V2 review and hardening
statement: Review feedback was converted into proportionality, semantic schemas, provenance, generated index, metrics and license triage.

title: Package 00R reconciliation, security and release baseline
statement: The audited GitHub baseline was hardened and made reproducible without migrations, production deployment or changes to real commercial data.
notes: Deferred Supabase/Auth/Company 360 and rejected direct import of non-canonical Package 02/03 changesets.

title: Package 04R Sync Bridge and Conflict UX
statement: Package 04R replaced silent revision-conflict overwrite behavior with durable local-first recovery, explicit human review, auth-safe foreground outbox delivery and serialized writes, then passed CI and merged through PR #7.
notes: PR #7 merged as 5d2d8aa5d1541010e03d2ca1926ba76a60efb3eb after workflow run 36283581505 succeeded on the final PR head. No real commercial data migration or Supabase remote activation occurred.

title: Package 05R Legacy Reconciliation
statement: Package 05R introduced reviewed, checkpointed and selectively reversible reconciliation from legacy leads to canonical Company/Contact, passed final CI and merged through PR #9 without bulk migration.
notes: An intermediate CI run correctly blocked release because of a new-test fixture initialization error. It was fixed before final workflow run 36285077211 succeeded. PR #9 merged as dad8edb2c3196f0c6e91b15489f685e87d90711d. No automatic migration of real commercial data or Supabase remote activation occurred.

title: Package 06R HTTPS Preview Deployment
statement: Package 06R converted the local-served DUTRA OS into a protected Railway HTTPS preview, corrected provider compatibility, verified the deployed main commit and health pipeline, and kept ephemeral filesystem state explicitly outside canonical persistence.
notes: Initial Railway attempts failed before the service configuration was aligned with current Railpack behavior. Final deployment ea0134ea-d6fa-46f4-adea-5db0b4c3b53a published main@9873644423a7f6bc204240dac3b4bb40d533fd4c successfully. Service has no persistent volume; HTTPS is a protected preview, not canonical storage.

title: OG-18 Smart Leads & Transcription queue
statement: OG-18 implemented additive lead intelligence fields, deterministic prioritization, semantic filters, richer client context and responsive cards while preserving state.leads and existing synchronization contracts.
notes: An initial CI run correctly caught a client-sheet contract regression after the table redesign; the Código OG text contract was restored and the next CI run passed. Real customer data is not committed and live import remains a separate runtime operation.

title: CIC-01 Next Best Action + Score Explicável
statement: CIC-01 unified score explanation and next-action context across Meu Dia/Mesa, Ficha Universal and Call AI, incorporated audit fixes for context invalidation and terminal states, and closed after final independent approval without merging PR #23.
notes: Main learnings: one deterministic score source; next-action changes invalidate dependent context; terminal states receive no invented action; all flows use shared contracts; cache varies with relevant commercial context; tests cover alternate UI paths. CIC-02 explicitly not started. PR #23 remains unmerged by instruction.

title: DUTRA Intelligence Compiler V1
statement: Conversation recovery and technical handoff were compiled into the existing Second Brain, routed domain Skills, context manifests, playbooks, incident prevention and regression-test contracts without moving dynamic customer records into global knowledge.
notes: Did not create a parallel memory database; reused docs/second-brain and .codex/skills. Dynamic client/proposal data remains in CRM/runtime.
